Name: Now Playing
Description: Album art, track info, time and progress across your keys, plus media controls. Works with Spotify, browsers and any player in the Windows volume popup - no sign-in.

com.clarkyau.nowplaying.art.Name: Album Art
com.clarkyau.nowplaying.art.Tooltip: The album cover. Neighbouring Album Art keys share one big picture.

com.clarkyau.nowplaying.info.Name: Track Info
com.clarkyau.nowplaying.info.Tooltip: Title, artist, album or player. Keys side by side work as one display, and long names scroll across them.

com.clarkyau.nowplaying.time.Name: Time
com.clarkyau.nowplaying.time.Tooltip: Time left or time played in the song.

com.clarkyau.nowplaying.progress.Name: Progress Bar
com.clarkyau.nowplaying.progress.Tooltip: How far through the song. Neighbouring Progress Bar keys share one bar.
